name: manual_217dff
claim: git -C <repo> worktree add <relative-path> resolves the relative path against <repo>, not the shell cwd, so the worktree is silently created inside the repo checkout; pass an absolute path and confirm git status of the repo is clean afterwards.

decisions.notes: Two worktrees landed inside the Core and Oramasys checkouts instead of the shared worktree hub. Detected only because the next cd failed; removed with git worktree remove and recreated with absolute paths.

rationale: Two worktrees landed inside the Core and Oramasys checkouts instead of the shared worktree hub. Detected only because the next cd failed; removed with git worktree remove and recreated with absolute paths.
